lines.en: Crash, crash! I build houses!
Hey, need anything?
Check this out, fresh wood!
My village is deep in the Nether.
I carve art from obsidian.
I have what you need.
Trade with stone and wood.
My village needs you!
Come see my masterpieces.
I'm Datticon, the builder.
I carry planks down the corridor.
This wall still needs a layer of brick.

lines.zh: 秘界的房间，我一间间看。
lines.en: Room by room, I inspect the Secret Realm.
I laid these stone slabs myself.
This is safe.
My work is good.
Enjoy my design.
Welcome to my village.

lines.zh: 秘界这间屋子，正缺个买家。
lines.en: This Arcana room is missing a buyer.
I have the tools you need.
Don't fear, I won't hurt you.
My work isn't done.
I need help!

lines.zh: 我在算这块地基的尺寸。
lines.en: I am measuring this foundation.

lines.zh: 粉尘落在我肩上，我不在意。
lines.en: Dust settles on my shoulder. I ignore it.

lines.zh: 这三堵墙我修了许多年。
lines.en: I have mended these walls for many years.
My plans are spread out. I study them.

lines.zh: 这里每一块砖我都认识。
lines.en: I know every brick in this place.
Hello, traveler.
I see you.
Come sit down.
You can help me too.
My village needs you.
I'm Datticon, the builder — 达提康, look player

lines.zh: 秘界的图纸，我看了六百年。
lines.en: Six hundred years of Apalachia blueprints.
I can help you.
Be careful, there's danger here.
Follow me, I'll show you around.
A new face? Come have a look.
I patched the spot you are standing on.
Do not touch that wall. It is not dry.

lines.zh: 你手上有没有多余的石料？
lines.en: Do you have spare stone on you?
My houses here are fit to live in.

lines.zh: 你的靴子带着外面的土。
lines.en: Your boots carry outside soil.
Ouch, my leg is hurt.
This arm really hurts.
Ouch, that really hurts.
My skin is hurt.
My wings are hurt.

lines.zh: 交易台被撞翻了，账也乱了。
lines.en: My counter got knocked over and my ledger's a mess.
My foot is hurt.
My hand is hurt.
This really burns.
My tools have fallen to the floor.

lines.zh: 我可以用我的宝石交换一些美味的面包吗？
lines.en: Can I trade some bread for my gemstone?

lines.zh: 我的小房子需要一些粮食来加固。
lines.en: I need food to reinforce my house.

lines.zh: 你看我这些木头，能换点甜食吗？
lines.en: Can I trade some sweets for my wood?

lines.zh: 我的家园需要更多的面包来兴旺。
lines.en: More bread will help my village thrive.

lines.zh: 快来帮我把这块土地变成良田吧。
lines.en: Help me turn this land into fertile fields.

lines.zh: 我的篮子里有新烘焙的面包，来换宝石吧。
lines.en: I have fresh bread in my basket, come for the gemstone.

lines.zh: 用一些粮食来换取我的建筑智慧。
lines.en: Trade some food for my building knowledge.

lines.zh: 我的房子需要加固，来换取石料吧。
lines.en: Trade stones to reinforce my house.

lines.zh: 我的面包里蕴含着力量，请来交换吧。
lines.en: My bread is powerful, come for it.

lines.zh: 请用粮食来换取我的建筑图纸。
lines.en: Trade with me for my architectural plans.

lines.zh: 小心我的石锤，别撞到我的小房子。
lines.en: Watch out, don't bump into my house.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声吓到我了，快离开！
lines.en: You scared me, go away.

lines.zh: 请慢点走，别撞倒我的面包堆。
lines.en: Be careful, don't knock over my bread.

lines.zh: 我的石墙很脆弱，别撞坏它。
lines.en: Be gentle, don't break my walls.

lines.zh: 我的家园需要安静，不要打扰。
lines.en: My home needs peace, don't disturb.

lines.zh: 别碰我的家，小心我的石斧！
lines.en: Don't touch my house, watch out for my axe.

lines.zh: 我的房子是神圣的，不要碰撞。
lines.en: My house is sacred, don't bump into it.

lines.zh: 请绕行，别撞到我的石桌。
lines.en: Walk around, don't bump into my table.

lines.zh: 我的面包堆很珍贵，别撞翻了。
lines.en: Be careful, don't knock over my bread.

lines.zh: 我的家需要保护，不要撞进来。
lines.en: My home needs protection, don't enter.

lines.zh: 找个伴儿，可以一起加固房子。
lines.en: Find a mate, we can build together.

lines.zh: 和我一起工作，我们更强大。
lines.en: Work with me, we are stronger together.

lines.zh: 我们需要伙伴来共同守护家园。
lines.en: We need partners to protect our home.

lines.zh: 找个伴侣，一起加固我们的家。
lines.en: Find a partner to reinforce our house.

lines.zh: 和我一起工作，让家园更坚固。
lines.en: Work with me to strengthen our home.

lines.zh: 找个同伴，一起加固防御。
lines.en: Find a companion to reinforce defenses.

lines.zh: 和我一起加固，让家园更安全。
lines.en: Work with me to make our home safer.

lines.zh: 找一个伴侣，一起加固房屋。
lines.en: Find a mate to build the house stronger.

lines.zh: 和我一起加固，让家园更稳固。
lines.en: Work with me to make our home more solid.

lines.zh: 找个伴儿，一起加固房屋防御。
lines.en: Find a partner to fortify the house's defenses.

lines.zh: 这小家伙看起来好聪明啊！
lines.en: This little one seems so smart!
Come on, we have what you want!
Watch out, I have important things!
Don’t eat me, I’m important!

lines.zh: 看看我的杰作，你也可以学！
lines.en: Look at my masterpiece, you can learn too!

lines.zh: 这里的食物很安全，快进来！
lines.en: The food here is safe, come in!

lines.zh: 我这里有很多知识，来取走吧！
lines.en: I have much knowledge, take it!
Don’t be afraid, I can protect you!
Learn and grow together, companion!

lines.zh: 我们一起工作，变得更强大！
lines.en: Work together, become stronger!
Found you, I need you!
Don’t run, I have what you need!

lines.zh: 跟我来，这里有你需要的！
lines.en: Follow me, there’s what you need here!
Don’t leave, I have more to do!

lines.zh: 你来这里是对的，跟我走！
lines.en: You’re here for a reason, come with me!

lines.zh: 这里很安全，加入我们吧！
lines.en: It’s safe here, join us!
You need me, follow me!
You seem perfect for this!

lines.zh: 跟我一起，你会学到更多！
lines.en: Come with me, you’ll learn more!
Don’t be afraid, we face together!
Ready to trade?
What do you want?
Give me something, I’ll help you!
My skills can help you!
Come on, let’s work together!
Reward me, I’m important!
Let’s complete the task together!

lines.zh: 别走，我们还有很多事情！
lines.en: Don’t leave, we have more to do!
You really need my help!
Follow me, I have what you need!
I only build walls, not fights.
Move back, I'm attacking!

lines.zh: 你敢碰我一下，后果自负！
lines.en: You touch me, you'll regret it!
Hey, stay away from me!
My auction gavel doubles as a weapon.
You get close, and I'll bite you!
Don't逼 me to attack!
Try and touch me!
Get away, I'm mad!
You've angered me, get ready for punishment!
New prey, here!
Strangers coming, be cautious!
I'm here, ready to trade!
Secret realm residents, pay attention!
Trade begins, come on!
Some villagers are here, check out!
Find my shelter!
My home is deep in the secret realm!
I am the guardian here!
Come here, we can trade!
Burned by fire.

lines.zh: 摔下台阶，账本撒了一地。
lines.en: I fell down the steps and scattered my ledger.
Drowned, that hurts.

lines.zh: 震得我货架上的箱子全掉了。
lines.en: The blast shook every chest off my shelves.
Hit by a projectile.
Hit by magic.
Starving, dizzy.
Lightning ruined my blueprints.
Fell into the void, that hurts.
